column2: # 中文：factor() 把两种类别列转换为因子；mutate() 保留其他列，赋值使转换结果保存到 listings。
# English: factor() converts the two categorical columns; mutate() keeps other columns and assignment stores the result in listings.
# 中文：filter() 的三个条件同时满足才保留：25 <= price <= 1000，bathrooms <= 5，边界值均包含。
# English: filter() requires all three conditions: 25 <= price <= 1000 and bathrooms <= 5, including all boundaries.
# 中文：drop_na() 删除指定三列任一缺失的房源，但 review_scores_rating 的 NA 可能仍然存在。
# English: drop_na() removes listings missing any of the three specified columns, but review_scores_rating can still contain NA.
# 中文：这些阈值是教程的样本定义，不证明被排除记录全是错误，也不保证其他变量没有异常值。
# English: These thresholds define the exercise sample; they neither establish that every excluded record is wrong nor guarantee other variables are free of unusual values.
# Note: # remember to check your file path is the same as mine above.
# Tutorial 1: coerce room_type from character to factor
property_type = factor(property_type)) # one line of code now
# Tutorial 2: filter out any extreme or questionable values
drop_na(price, bedrooms, bathrooms) # and drop any missing (na) values
